reloadDesign.userRequest: 2026-10-07: '장전은 왼손 y버튼 두번누르면 왼손 장전 오른손은 b버튼 두번 누르면 장전으로 만들 수 있겠어? 아마 게임 코드를 수정해야 할지도 몰라.' - per-hand reload on a double tap of that hand's upper face button.
gameApi: PlayerController.reload_all_weapons() : void () - the path the game's own R key takes
PlayerInputController.reloadPressed / ReloadInput(bool) - the input plumbing behind R
reloadDesign.source: artifacts/recon-asm/full/assembly-recon.json (all-type member dump of tools/interop/Assembly-CSharp.dll, sha256 0494F1BA5514BBBE9632A328A20565E53554C312447E7F8380F5ECE9B927EED5), re-derived by the assembly-aim-slot-pin check every verifier run
reloadDesign.proves: The game reloads PER WEAPON OBJECT and every Weapon exposes its own public virtual reload(), so the mod can reload one hand's weapon without touching the other: per-hand reload needs no edit to the game's code, only a call to the game's own API - the same shape as the per-slot fire API in aimDesign.handSlotEvidence (D-051).
reloadDesign.doesNotProve: That a given weapon object is the hand's active slot weapon at that moment, what the int parameter of force_reload selects, whether the weapon must be idle, or that the game's own state machine accepts anything except PlayerController.reload_all_weapons(). Stage 6B questions - Q-037.
reloadDesign.fallback: If per-hand reload cannot be proven, the double tap forwards to the game's own single 재장전 (PlayerController.reload_all_weapons(), the R path) and that downgrade is recorded in D-059 + Q-037, never shipped silently.

modes.note: Each hand aims and fires its own weapon; two independent aim states. The user asked for this reading on 2026-10-07 and the game has a per-hand-slot firing model (see handSlotEvidence). It is the ONLY mode since D-056.

modesRemoved.was: PROPOSED_LINK_ON_RANGE with a support point on manifest.weapons[].grab_points[support] and auto/toggle/hold engagement
modesRemoved.reason: The user removed the two-hand link outright ('투핸드 링크 없애라'). There is therefore no link radius, no support point, no TwoHandMode setting and no link gesture; the grip is not a link control. Nothing about this is a scope cut to be reversed silently - re-adding a link needs a new user decision and a fresh Stage 6B design pass.

handSlotEvidence.source: tools/interop/Assembly-CSharp.dll (game-derived, git-ignored) read only by src/diagnostics/AssemblyEvidence.cs; re-derived every verifier run by tests/verify.ps1 (assembly-aim-slot-pin) into artifacts/assembly-aim-slot/
handSlotEvidence.weaponSlotEnum: EWeaponSlot = LEFT_HAND, RIGHT_HAND, LEFT_TOP_HAND, RIGHT_TOP_HAND, PASSIVE, COUNT
handSlotEvidence.aimTransformParam: Weapon.shoot_forward(bool, float, bool, bool, float, bool, ElementalDamageType, bool, UnityEngine.Transform) -> EnemyCollider
handSlotEvidence.proves: The game's own weapon model is per hand slot (LEFT_HAND / RIGHT_HAND / LEFT_TOP_HAND / RIGHT_TOP_HAND / PASSIVE) and firing is dispatched per slot, so independent per-hand aim and fire has a game-side foundation for the mod to drive instead of invent.
handSlotEvidence.doesNotProve: That two slots can hold and aim simultaneously in a VR session, that each slot's aim direction can be redirected independently, that the trailing Transform parameter is the aim origin, or that aim assist (get_closes_enemy_direction, aim_assist_radius) will not fight a hand-driven direction. Those are Stage 6B runtime questions.

aimSmoothing.note: Opt-in only; a shipping reference mod smooths aim, but smoothing reads as input lag in a VR conversion.

flatControlNotes.interact: 상호작용 = Z (main) / G (alt) - CONFIRMED from the game's own keybinding menu (D-058); Q-034 answered, matching PlayerInputController.Interact
flatControlNotes.reload: 재장전 = R (main) / V (alt) - meaning confirmed by the menu (D-058). The flat game has ONE reload key, so the per-hand split is the mod's own call (D-059): reload_off/reload_dominant fire on a double tap of that hand's upper face button and are expected to reach Weapon.reload() on that hand's weapon (Q-037)
flatControlNotes.special_ability: 특수 능력 = SHIFT (main) / CTRL (alt) - PlayerInputController.SpecialAbility; NOT a separate VR action, and Q-035 is ANSWERED (D-059): the user reports the SCOUT's special ability IS the dash, so the mod's dash (left X) forwards to SHIFT and stays there. Other characters may carry a different 특수 능력, which is the game's business - the mod forwards to its key, not to a named ability
